acceptanceCriteria: WorkItemState exposes a pure legal-transition predicate and checked transition operation covering the canonical forward path, explicit recovery states, and terminal states; illegal backward, skipped, and post-terminal transitions fail closed.

Lifecycle transition checks do not read files, call Git, execute commands, infer human authority, or synthesize evidence; existing DecisionState, AuthorityState, and EvidenceState remain independent types.

Existing snake_case serialization for lifecycle and governance enums remains compatible, and historical/unknown records are not rewritten; tests cover old values, illegal transitions, and recovery/terminal behavior.
Tri-language Work Item documentation records before/after responsibility boundaries, unchanged external contracts, compatibility, verification, risks, and P3 physical-execution audit evidence.
Focused core tests, workspace tests, governance checks, and hosted PR checks pass.
goal: A typed, pure lifecycle transition boundary rejects illegal state changes without changing serialized records or granting authorization, while documentation records the separation and verification evidence.
intent: Make lifecycle transitions explicit and keep lifecycle state separate from evidence, governance decision, authority, and historical projection.
